items.title: A Study of Early Mobilisation Following Emergency Abdominal Surgery
items.briefSummary: This trial evaluates whether a structured early-mobilisation protocol reduces postoperative complications and length of stay after emergency abdominal surgery.

items.title: Comparing Two Insulin Titration Strategies in Hospitalised Patients With Type 2 Diabetes
items.briefSummary: A pragmatic randomised trial comparing basal-bolus versus basal-plus insulin titration strategies for glycaemic control during hospital admission.

items.title: Long-Term Outcomes Registry for Percutaneous Coronary Intervention in South Western Sydney
items.briefSummary: An observational registry tracking long-term cardiovascular outcomes following percutaneous coronary intervention across South Western Sydney sites.
